critical_code_review_comments: GrantApplicationInput not viewed but PATCH accepts arbitrary keys via model_dump(exclude_unset=True); ensure Pydantic model restricts to {status, deadline, notes} to avoid client-side field injection.

toggle_item and update_app use ObjectId(aid) without try/except — an invalid aid string will raise 500 (bson.errors.InvalidId) instead of 400/404. Consider wrapping ObjectId(aid) in a helper that returns 404 on invalid IDs.
grants.py uses `from core import *` — acceptable within the repo pattern but hides dependencies; not blocking.
Frontend Apoios.jsx: deleteApp reads grant_id lookup from current apps state before setting — logic works but relies on stale closure; low priority.
